name: Truss
description: A top chord with a triangulated web below it — the same truss bay repeated the length of the span.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8%; width: 100%; height: 11%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 19%; width: 100%; height: 73%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 44% 0, 56% 0, 100% 100%, 76% 100%, 50% 34%, 24% 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 44% 0, 56% 0, 100% 100%, 76% 100%, 50% 34%, 24% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
